integrity: Proof by finite Markov generator and polynomial identities; symbolic verification program included. No experimental or independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one vacancy on four sites; rates positive, |bias|<1; no other filling, size, or random-ensemble conclusion. General periodic-walker stationary drift is classical; the evaluated claim is its complete trap-rate bias-parity classification and sign law.
title: An exact hidden bias-reversal surface in the four-site one-vacancy exclusion process
